name: Vaultwarden

database.label: Bundled SQLite by default; MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL backends are available via alternate build tags for larger multi-user deployments

resourceFootprint.notes: Written in Rust, Vaultwarden is one of the lightest self-hosted apps you can run — well under 100 MB RAM at idle for a family-sized vault. Footprint grows only slightly with more users, organizations and file attachments.

screenshots.label: Dashboard
screenshots.altEn: Vaultwarden web vault showing a list of stored logins and secure notes
screenshots.altBg: Уеб трезор на Vaultwarden със списък от запазени пароли и защитени бележки

screenshots.label: Security Reports
screenshots.altEn: Vaultwarden security reports screen highlighting exposed, reused and weak passwords across the vault
screenshots.altBg: Екран с доклади за сигурност във Vaultwarden, показващ компрометирани, повтарящи се и слаби пароли в трезора

screenshots.label: Two-Step Login
screenshots.altEn: Vaultwarden two-step login settings showing authenticator app, passkey and Duo provider options
screenshots.altBg: Настройки за двустъпково влизане във Vaultwarden с authenticator app, passkey и Duo опции

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: vaultwarden
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DOMAIN: "https://vault.example.com"
      SIGNUPS_ALLOWED: "false"
      WEBSOCKET_ENABLED: "true"
    volumes:
      - vw-data:/data
    ports:
      - "8080:80"

volumes:
  vw-data:
descriptionEn: Vaultwarden is an unofficial, lightweight Bitwarden-compatible server written in Rust, letting you self-host a password manager that works with every official Bitwarden client (browser, mobile, desktop, CLI). It unlocks premium features like TOTP generation, file attachments and emergency access for free, and runs comfortably on tiny hardware like a Raspberry Pi.
descriptionBg: Vaultwarden е неофициален, лек сървър, съвместим с Bitwarden, написан на Rust, който позволява self-hosting на мениджър за пароли, работещ с всички официални Bitwarden клиенти (браузър, мобилни, десктоп, CLI). Отключва безплатно премиум функции като TOTP генериране, прикачени файлове и аварийни контакти, и работи спокойно на съвсем малък хардуер като Raspberry Pi.
taglineBg: Лек, self-hosted трезор за пароли, съвместим с Bitwarden.
